question: How many customers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer

question: How many tracks are in the database?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track

question: List all genre names.
sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre

question: How many customers are from Brazil?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: What is the total revenue across all invoices?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice

question: What is the longest track's name?
sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the first and last names of all employees with the title 'Sales Support Agent'.
sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent'

question: How many invoices were issued in 2010?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2010'

question: What is the average invoice total?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) FROM Invoice

question: How many playlists are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Playlist

question: How many tracks does each genre have?
sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId

question: What is the total revenue per billing country?
sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry

question: Which 5 countries have the most customers?
sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many albums does each artist have? Only include artists with more than 10 albums.
sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

question: What is the total revenue for each year?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate), ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice GROUP BY 1

question: Which media types are used by tracks, and how many tracks use each?
sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId

question: List the names of all tracks on the album 'Let There Be Rock'.
sql: SELECT t.Name FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId WHERE a.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'

question: How many customers does each sales support agent look after? Show the agent's full name.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName, COUNT(*) FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId

question: What is the average track length in minutes for each genre?
sql: SELECT g.Name, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId

question: How many tracks are in each playlist? Show the playlist name.
sql: SELECT p.Name, COUNT(pt.TrackId) FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId

question: Which 5 customers spent the most in total? Show their full names and total spend.
sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS s FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the monthly revenue for 2012?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate), ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2012' GROUP BY 1

question: Which tracks generated more than $3 in total revenue? Show track name and revenue.
sql: SELECT t.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS r FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY t.TrackId HAVING r > 3

question: Which genre generated the most revenue?
sql: SELECT g.Name FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which artist has earned the most revenue from track sales?
sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which sales support agent's customers generated the most total revenue? Give the agent's full name.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine)

question: Which customers have spent more than the average customer's total spend? Show full names.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS t FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId) SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName FROM s JOIN Customer c ON s.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE s.t > (SELECT AVG(t) FROM s)

question: For each country, what is the average total spend per customer?
sql: SELECT c.Country, ROUND(SUM(i.Total) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerId), 2) FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country

question: Which employees manage other employees, and how many direct reports does each have? Show full names.
sql: SELECT m.FirstName || ' ' || m.LastName, COUNT(*) FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId GROUP BY m.EmployeeId

question: What percentage of total revenue came from the USA? Round to 2 decimals.
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN BillingCountry = 'USA' THEN Total END) / SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice

question: Which year had the highest revenue growth compared to the previous year?
sql: WITH y AS (SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS yr, SUM(Total) AS r FROM Invoice GROUP BY 1) SELECT yr FROM (SELECT yr, r - LAG(r) OVER (ORDER BY yr) AS g FROM y) WHERE g IS NOT NULL ORDER BY g DESC LIMIT 1
